intro: The Binding is the culminating rite for warlocks seeking to command a felhunter. Overseen by the enigmatic summoner Strahad Farsan above Ratchet, the ritual uses the restored Tome of the Cabal to rip an aggressive demonic predator from the Nether and force it into subjugation through trial of combat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're are sufficiently prepared, then we should begin. Let me explain the process to you.
I will begin by creating the basic summoning circle. When that is finished, my acolytes will use the rods of channeling to create the greater circle.

Once that is done, read the incantation from the Tome of the Cabal, and the felhunter will be pulled forth. Be careful, friend. A felhunter is a powerful foe, and I'd like to see you keep your head on your shoulders.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Every warlock should have a felhunter at his command. Though it be difficult to tame, the powers it brings to its master far outweigh the cost.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I must say I'm impressed, friend. When I faced down my felhunter, I barely escaped with my life. I sense that you have the potential to become one of the most powerful warlocks of this era.
